_comment: EXAMPLE shared lock-server config for taskdb. Shipped DISABLED: out of the box taskdb locks locally (per-clone SQLite) and never dials Postgres. To coordinate locks across machines, stand up your own Postgres lock registry (see scripts/taskdb/lockserver-provision.sql), reach it over an SSH tunnel, and either edit this file in place or export TASKDB_LOCK_DSN — the env override wins and enables remote locking on its own, so no credential ever has to be committed. This file configures ONLY task locking; tasks/*.json in git remain the authority for all task content and the DAG. TASKDB_LOCK_DISABLE=1 forces local-only regardless of this file.
